[[File:Energy Refill.png|thumb]]
[[File:Alliance Mission Energy Refill.png|thumb]]
'''Energy Refills''' are items that, like what the name implies, recharges your [[Energy]]. There are two types of Refills: Mission Energy, and [[Alliance Mission]] Energy.

The Mission Energy Refill can be bought for 40 [[File:Energon.png|40px|link=Energon]] .

Alliance Mission Energy Refills are only available to buy on Alliance days, and the first costs 30 [[File:Energon.png|40px|link=Energon]], then 45, 60, 75, and 90, limit 5 each day.

Both of these items can be obtained as prizes for completing certain [[Objectives]], or in the case of the Alliance Mission Energy Refill, the Alliance [[Crystal]]s and the Raid Store. The Mission Energy Refill completely refills your Mission Energy, while Alliance Mission Energy refills only recharge 1. If you don't use the refills, Mission Energy takes 6 minutes to recharge, and Alliance Misison energy <strike>60</strike> 45 minutes.
[[File:Empty Energy.png|thumb]]
It isn't wise to use your refill when you have at least 3 Mission energy left over; you're wasting the energy and in return, you lose three extra "advances". Use it when you have no energy left, or if you can't travel any further if the mission requires more than 1 energy to keep exploring.
